highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports WinUI and Apple platform fixes from the v4 line.

bullets.lead: Apple library and app TFM alignment backported
bullets.detail: The 26.0 library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs from v4 have been backported so .NET 9 consumers on Apple platforms pick up the correct native assets.
Fixes a missing WinUI Projection DLL that caused runtime failures for .NET 9 WinUI consumers.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM alignment.
